pol_priv_s1_li2: When you browse our Site: We automatically receive your computer’s internet protocol (IP) address and information about your browser and operating system.
pol_priv_s1_li3: Email marketing (where legally permitted): With your consent, we may send you emails about Melara Pro LLC, our products, promotions, and updates. Consent may be established through actions such as subscribing to our newsletter, entering your email during checkout (without opting out), or participating in events, surveys, or contests where you are notified of marketing communications.
pol_priv_s1_p2: All marketing emails will include a clear “unsubscribe” option. Once you opt out, we will stop sending you marketing emails. Transactional and legally required communications (such as receipts, order confirmations, or policy updates) are not affected by marketing preferences.
pol_priv_s1_p3: We may use your personal information to:
pol_priv_use_1: Communicate and build a relationship with you

pol_priv_use_3: Process and fulfill transactions and requests

pol_priv_use_5: Conduct market research and improve our Site and services
pol_priv_use_6: Send marketing materials and targeted advertising (where permitted)
pol_priv_use_7: Detect, deter, and prevent fraud or illegal activity
pol_priv_s1_p4: If you wish to stop receiving marketing communications, you may opt out at any time by clicking “unsubscribe” in our emails or contacting us at support@melarapro.com.
pol_priv_s1_p5: We may release personal data if required by law, or when we believe it is necessary to comply with government requests, enforce our policies, or protect our rights and the safety of others.
pol_priv_s2_p1:
How do we obtain your consent?
By providing personal information to complete a transaction, verify a payment, place an order, arrange a delivery, or request a return, you consent to our collecting and using it for that purpose. If we ask for information for any secondary purpose (such as marketing), we will either ask you directly for explicit consent or provide you with an option to decline.
pol_priv_s2_p2:
How do you withdraw your consent?
If you change your mind, you may withdraw your consent with future effect at any time by contacting us at support@melarapro.com or by using the unsubscribe instructions included in our communications. Withdrawing consent will not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.
pol_priv_s2_p3: Certain uses of your data may not require consent, including:
pol_priv_s2_li1: To fulfill our contractual obligations to you
pol_priv_s2_li2: To comply with legal obligations or investigations
pol_priv_s2_li3: Where we have a legitimate business interest, except where your rights override such interests
pol_priv_s2_p4: You may request to view, update, or delete your personal information at any time by emailing support@melarapro.com. We will not retain your data longer than necessary for the purposes collected, except as required by law.
